description: META'S OWN AI AGENT on the brand's WhatsApp number (Meta hosts it and bills the business about 4-5 cents a message; Hermoso charges nothing). action: status (default: eligibility, on/off, knowledge counts, budget), eligibility, onboard, get_settings, update_settings {enabled, audience everyone|allowlisted, handoff {enabled, message, messageSelection}, followup {enabled, intervalSeconds, message}, neverSay[]}, get_business_info / set_business_info {businessInfo: {description, paymentMethods, returnPolicy, purchaseInfo, shipping, contact {email, hours, address}}} / clear_business_info, list_faqs / add_faq / update_faq / delete_faq {id, question, answer}, list_websites / add_website / update_website / delete_website {url, singleUrls[], includedUrlPatterns[] ...}, list_files / upload_file {url, fileName: pdf, doc, docx, png, jpg} / delete_file, list_skills / add_skill / update_skill / delete_skill {title, description, skill}, list_connectors / add_connector / update_connector / delete_connector {name, description, baseUrl, protocol HTTP|MCP, authType, authConfig}, connector_api_key / connector_oauth {id, authConfig} / connector_certificate {id, clientCertificate, clientKey, caCertificate: PEM, mTLS} / refresh_connector_tools / connector_logs {id}, CONNECTOR TOOLS (the operations an HTTP connector lets the agent call, e.g. order status): list_connector_tools / get_connector_tool / add_connector_tool / update_connector_tool (only what changes) / delete_connector_tool / run_connector_tool {connectorId, toolId, name, description, requestDefinition {method, path "/orders/{order_id}", path_parameters, query_parameters, headers, body {params, required}}, userAuthRequired, transformationSpec, input} (a run calls the business's API for real; non-GET tools need confirm:true), UI SKILLS (when the agent answers with a rich message): list_ui_skills / get_ui_skill / add_ui_skill {title, componentType cta_url|image|carousel_url|carousel_quick_reply|carousel_multi_quick_reply|interactive_list|interactive_reply_buttons|location|location_request|flow|catalog_message|multi_product|document|video, instruction, status enabled|disabled, flowId} / update_ui_skill {id, title, status, instruction} / delete_ui_skill, EVALUATIONS (Meta simulates and scores conversations, no customer is messaged): list_eval_cases / run_eval {evalCaseIds} / get_eval_run {jobId} / get_eval_summary {summaryIds} / get_eval_details {evalIds}, list_allowlist / allow {phone|bsuid} / disallow {id}, get_budget / set_budget {budgets: [{unit token|ai_turn, days 1|7|14|30, max}]}, test {message, conversationId} (not billed by Meta), send_event {to, type, description, payload}, get_event {id}, thread_control {to, control take|release|pass, metadata}, delete_agent. Deletes and turning it on for everyone need confirm:true. The business must first accept the Meta Business Agent terms in WhatsApp Manager, and add a payment method in Billing Hub before audience everyone. For Hermoso's own AI on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and comments instead, use set_ai_replies.
